title: 为什么在中国旅行如此安心
author: Two Brits On The Go / Ingrid

sentences.en: We felt completely safe walking around the city at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上在城市里散步，我们感到非常安全。

sentences.en: You can pay for almost everything with just one mobile app.
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以用一个手机应用支付所有开销。

sentences.en: We booked high-speed rail tickets and hotels through an app.
sentences.zh: 我们通过应用预订了高铁票和酒店。

sentences.en: Even the language problem was not a real barrier.
sentences.zh: 就连语言问题也不是真正的障碍。

sentences.en: Many locals are learning English and happy to help.
sentences.zh: 许多当地人都在学英语，也很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: Strangers shared their food and gave us travel advice.
sentences.zh: 陌生人分享他们的食物，还给了我们旅行建议。

sentences.en: The ancient city wall gave us a wonderful sense of history.
sentences.zh: 古城墙让我们感受到美妙的历史气息。

sentences.en: Food in China is delicious and surprisingly affordable.
sentences.zh: 中国美食很好吃，而且出奇地实惠。

sentences.en: A simple breakfast can cost as little as three dollars.
sentences.zh: 一顿简单的早餐可能只要三美元。

sentences.en: People here live freely and follow their own hearts.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们活得自在，遵从自己的内心。

sentences.en: This trip changed many of my wrong ideas about China.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行改变了我许多对中国的错误看法。

sentences.en: China is a huge and open world, waiting to be explored.
sentences.zh: 中国是一个广阔而开放的世界，正等待被探索。
